title: A complete tool window
description:
Build the model behind a game tool: an entity list, an inspector for the selected entity, a log, and saved settings.

```
entities: 3 (filter "gob" -> 1)
selected goblin: hp 12, speed 1.5
set hp "15" -> ok; set speed "fast" -> refused (logged)
log: 2 lines; settings saved: filter, selection, window sizes
```
hints: Keep the selection as an entity id, not an index, so it survives filtering and sorting (lesson 14.06).
Draw it with Dear ImGui last; get the model right with plain tests first.
requirements: Combine the pieces of this milestone: a filtered list, field editing from text, a log and persistence.
The UI layer would only read this model and call its functions.
Keep the selection valid when the selected entity is removed.
